**![](old/akimsemey/other/%D1%81%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B0.jpg)**

► [Rules for researchers working in the reading rooms of the state archives of the Republic of Kazakhstan](old/akimsemey/upload/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B0%20%20%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BE%D1%82%D1%8B%20%D0%B2%20%D1%87%D0%B8%D1%82%20%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%BB.doc)

*Approved by order of the Chairman of the Committee for Archives and Documentation Management of the Ministry of Culture, Information and Public Accord of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 58 of 2 October 2000*

Modern information technologies are increasingly used in the archive’s work. To ensure the safety of documents more reliably, the East Kazakhstan State Archive installed, a few years ago, a system for tracking the movement of files in the reading room.

![](old/akimsemey/upload/IMG_1951.JPG)

![](old/akimsemey/upload/IMG_2361.JPG)

For collections that have been transferred to microfilm, the archive has acquired a more advanced reading device. The reading room has a separate computer for researchers to view the “Electronic Fonds Catalogue” and the “Archive Registrar”, and researchers can scan documents themselves on a flatbed scanner.

![](old/akimsemey/upload/%D0%91%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%B5%D0%B2.jpg)

A multimedia projector and screen have been acquired for multimedia presentations, slide shows and films.

The introduction of modern technology makes the work of archivists and researchers in the State Archive reading room much easier.

**ADMINISTRATIVE AND TERRITORIAL DIVISION**

- shows in chronological order the administrative and territorial changes in East Kazakhstan over several decades, tracing not only changes in the borders of administrative and territorial units but also all renamings, from districts down to settlements.

[VIEW](http://e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz/ru/DataBases/BaseAreas)

**BOOK OF MEMORY**

- contains brief biographical data on soldiers drafted from the districts of East Kazakhstan Region who were killed in action, died of wounds and illness in hospitals, or went missing in the Great Patriotic War of 1941–1945. Each entry of the database contains a set of information about the soldier: surname, first name, patronymic, year and place of birth, and the military commissariat that drafted him. Where these data differ, variants are given in brackets, since the information came from different sources. Next comes information about his wartime fate: date of death and place of burial. Where data differ, see the additional information in the notes.

The database is still being filled in; at present, data for the Zaisan, Glubokoye, Markakol and Samara districts of East Kazakhstan Region are being entered.

[VIEW](http://e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz/ru/DataBases/BaseBooks)

**LEAVE YOUR MARK ON HISTORY**

- bibliographic information about Heroes of the Soviet Union and Heroes of Socialist Labour from East Kazakhstan, about honoured workers in various fields, and about famous people of East Kazakhstan. The database is constantly updated.

[VIEW](http://e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz/ru/DataBases/BaseHistMark)

**ELECTRONIC FONDS CATALOGUE**

- makes it possible to quickly find where a fonds is held, the fonds numbers, the number of inventories and the extreme dates of documents, and to view files and the documents they contain. The database is constantly updated. Researchers can partially view the full text of documents of the fonds of the local executive bodies, “Ust-Kamenogorsk City Council of People's Deputies and its Executive Committee (gorispolkom)”, and of the personal fonds of B. G. Gerasimov, Aleksei Nikolaevich and Boris Alekseevich Belosludov, N. Ya. Konshin and Ya. Ya. Yaunrodzin.

[VIEW](http://e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz/ru/DataBases/BaseEFond)

**When using information from these documents in your work, please cite the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region.**

The State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region was established in 1940 under the archive department of the administration of the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs of the Kazakh SSR for East Kazakhstan Region.

By order of the administration of the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs of the Kazakh SSR No. 68 of 31 October 1941, the archive department was renamed the department of state archives of the administration of the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs (NKVD) of the Kazakh SSR for East Kazakhstan Region. The regional state archive came under the department of state archives. Until 1946 the head of the archive department, and then of the department of state archives, acted as director of the regional state archive.

On the basis of the order of the Council of People's Commissars of the USSR No. 130092-r of 2 September 1945 and of the NKVD of the USSR No. 381 of 12 September 1945, the state archives of the USSR were included among research institutions.

In 1946 the department of state archives was renamed the archive department of the administration of the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs of the Kazakh SSR for East Kazakhstan Region and, from March 1946, came under the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Kazakh SSR for East Kazakhstan Region. The regional state archive was subordinate to the archive department.

In 1957 the archive department came under the department of internal affairs of the executive committee of the East Kazakhstan Regional Council of Workers' Deputies.

In pursuance of the resolution of the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR No. 548 of 17 June 1960 “On transforming the archive administration of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Kazakh SSR into an archive administration under the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR” and of the decision of the East Kazakhstan regional executive committee No. 303 of 30 June 1960, the archive department began to operate under the executive committee of the East Kazakhstan Council of Workers' Deputies.

In accordance with the resolution of the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR of 21 May 1963 “On the creation of territorial and regional state archives”, the Zaisan branch of the regional state archive was established, serving the town of Zaisan and the Zaisan and Kurchum districts; in July 1963, the Zyryanovsk branch, serving the town of Zyryanovsk, the town of Serebryansk, and the Bolshenarym, Samara and Zyryanovsk districts. The towns of Leninogorsk, Ust-Kamenogorsk and Shemonaikha and the Glubokoye, Ulan, Tavrichesky and Shemonaikha districts came under the control of the regional state archive. By the resolution of the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR of 11 January 1966, the Leninogorsk branch of the regional state archive was created, serving the town of Leninogorsk and the Shemonaikha district.

By 1967 the network of archival institutions of the region was fully formed and consisted of:

1. The archive department under the executive committee of the East Kazakhstan Regional Council of Workers' Deputies;

2. The State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region;

3. The Zaisan branch of the regional state archive;

4. The Zyryanovsk branch of the regional state archive;

5. The Leninogorsk branch of the regional state archive.

From 7 October 1977, in accordance with the Constitution of the USSR, the Councils of Workers' Deputies were renamed Councils of People's Deputies. The archive department accordingly became known as the archive department under the executive committee of the East Kazakhstan Regional Council of People's Deputies.

Between 1977 and 1991, self-financing district and city archives of personnel records were created under the district and city executive committees of the region. They had the rights of a legal entity and accounts in State Bank branches, were subordinate to the city and district executive committees in organisational, staffing and financial matters, and received scientific and methodological guidance and supervision from the archive department.

In accordance with the decision of the East Kazakhstan regional executive committee No. 671 of 18 December 1980, the archive department became known as the archive department of the executive committee of the East Kazakhstan Regional Council of People's Deputies.

The archive department, the regional state archive and its branches, and the self-financing archives of personnel records formed part of a single system of the Main Archive Administration under the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR, with staffing tables and payroll funds approved by the republican archive administration.

As of 1 January 1992 the network of archival institutions of the region comprised the archive department, the regional state archive and its branches, and 10 self-financing archives of personnel records.

In accordance with the resolution of the 9th session of the 21st convocation of the East Kazakhstan Regional Council of People's Deputies of 20 February 1992 “On the abolition of departments, administrations and other structural units of the executive committee of the regional council”, and on the basis of the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On the suspension of certain provisions of the Constitution (Basic Law) of the Kazakh SSR during the transition period”, the archive department was abolished.

In accordance with the decision of the Head of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration No. 41 of 9 March 1992 “On improving the structure of the executive and administrative bodies of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration”, the archive department of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration was “…defined as a management body funded from the regional budget”.

On the basis of the decision of the Head of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration No. 109 of 13 August 1992, the archive department was reorganised into the administration of archives and documentation of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration. The regional state archive came under it.

In accordance with order of the Head of the East Kazakhstan Regional Administration No. 336-r of 27 April 1992 “On the creation of district and city archives of personnel records under the district and city administrations of East Kazakhstan Region”, the self-financing archives of personnel records were transformed into district and city archives of personnel records under the district and city administrations, funded from district and city budgets.

In accordance with Article 87 of the Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan, adopted on 30 August 1995, from December 1995 local executive bodies were headed by the Akims of the respective administrative and territorial units. As a result, the administration of archives and documentation became known as the administration of archives and documentation of East Kazakhstan Region.

By order of the Akim of East Kazakhstan Region No. 1-63r of 15 February 1996 “On improving the structure of the regional executive bodies”, the administration of archives and documentation was reorganised into the archive administration of East Kazakhstan Region.

By Decree of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 3 May 1997 “On further measures to improve the administrative and territorial structure of the Republic of Kazakhstan”, the Semipalatinsk Region was abolished.

The Ayagoz branch (serving the Ayagoz and Urdzhar districts) and the Char branch were added to the three branches of the regional state archive. The latter, on the basis of the order of the Akim of East Kazakhstan Region No. 1-125-r of 1 September 1997 “On improving the network of public service in the Zharma District of East Kazakhstan Region”, was abolished from 1 November 1997. On the basis of the Char branch and the Zharma district archive, the Zharma branch of the regional state archive was organised, serving the Zharma and Kokpekty districts. Thus, the network of archival institutions of the region, besides the administration, the Centre for Documentation of Recent History in Semipalatinsk and the district archives, included the regional state archive and its five branches: Ayagoz, Zharma, Zaisan, Zyryanovsk and Leninogorsk.

On the basis of the resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 65 of 7 May 2009 “Certain issues of state archival institutions of East Kazakhstan Region”, the regional state archive and its branches were separated from the regional administration of archives and documentation as independent legal entities.

By resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 10 of 23 January 2012 “On renaming state archival institutions”, the state institution “State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region” was reorganised into the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region.

In January 2013, on the basis of the resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 2 of 10 January 2013 “On the reorganisation of certain state archival institutions of East Kazakhstan Region”, branches of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region were created again, consisting of:

- the Ayagoz branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, serving the Ayagoz and Urdzhar districts;

- the Zharma branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, serving the Zharma and Kokpekty districts;

- the Zaisan branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, serving the Zaisan, Kurchum and Tarbagatay districts;

- the Zyryanovsk branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, serving the Zyryanovsk and Katon-Karagay districts;

- the Ridder branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, serving the town of Ridder and the Shemonaikha district;

- the Ust-Kamenogorsk branch for personnel records of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region, formed on the basis of the department for handling socio-legal requests of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region.

The service area of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region included the city of Ust-Kamenogorsk and the Glubokoye and Ulan districts.

By resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 196 of 30 July 2013 “On certain issues of state institutions of the Department of Culture of East Kazakhstan Region and the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region”, the state institution “Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region” was reorganised by merging with the state institution “Department of Culture of East Kazakhstan Region”. As a result, the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Administration of Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region and its branches, on the basis of the resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 250 of 23 September 2013 “On renaming communal state institutions and communal state-owned enterprises of the Department of Culture, Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region”, came under the state institution “Department of Culture, Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region”.

In 2019 the Zyryanovsk branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Department of Culture, Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region was renamed. On the basis of Decree of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 821 of 28 December 2018, the Zyryanovsk District and the town of Zyryanovsk of East Kazakhstan Region were renamed the Altai District and the town of Altai. As a result, on 11 February 2019 the Zyryanovsk branch underwent state re-registration with the justice authorities and became known as the Altai branch of the Communal State Institution “State Archive” of the Department of Culture, Archives and Documentation of East Kazakhstan Region.

Further changes in the subordination of the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region took place in 2020. By resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 188 of 11 June 2020, the state institution “Department of Digitalisation and Archives of East Kazakhstan Region” was created, and the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region came under it.

On the basis of Decree of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On certain issues of the administrative and territorial structure” No. 887 of 4 May 2022, the Abai Region was formed, with its administrative centre in the city of Semey, by separation from East Kazakhstan Region. As a result, by resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat No. 138 of 7 June 2022, the Ayagoz and Zharma branches of the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region were deregistered; they came under the newly formed state institution “Centre for Documentation of Recent History” of the Department of Culture, Language Development and Archival Affairs of Abai Region.

| **Term** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Archive** | the totality of archival documents, as well as an archival institution or a structural unit of an institution, organisation or enterprise that receives and keeps archival documents in the interests of users |
| **Archival document** | a document that is kept or is subject to being kept because of its significance for society, or that is of value to its owner |
| **Archival inventory** | an archival finding aid containing a systematic list of the storage units of an archival fonds or collection, intended for their accounting and for revealing their content |
| **Archival fonds** | a body of documents that are historically or logically connected with one another |
| **Archival catalogue** | an archival finding aid in which information about archival documents is arranged according to a chosen classification scheme |
| **Archival index** | an archival finding aid containing a systematic list of the names of subjects or objects about which archival documents hold information, with their search data |
| **Archival collection** | a body of documents formed in the activity of fonds creators and united by one or several features |
| **Archival finding aid** | a reference tool intended for finding information about archival fonds and/or archival documents |
| **Archival affairs** | the field of activity of individuals and legal entities connected with forming the National Archival Fonds, establishing archives, archival fonds and collections, and organising their storage and use |
| **Archival certificate** | an official document with legal force containing information on the subject of a request and the search data of documents |
| **Archival copy** | an official document of the archive reproducing the text or image of an archival document with an indication of its search data |
| **Archive repository** | a specially equipped room for storing archival documents |
| **Audiovisual document** | a document containing pictorial and sound information |
| **Departmental archive** | an institution or structural unit of a state legal entity that collects, temporarily keeps and uses documents of the National Archival Fonds, as well as documents not included in it |
| **State archive** | a state institution authorised to collect (acquire), permanently keep and organise the use of documents of the National Archival Fonds |
| **State insurance fund of document copies** | a body of insurance copies of documents of the National Archival Fonds that are of lasting importance to the state and irreplaceable if lost |
| **File** | a document or a body of documents relating to one question or area of activity, placed in a separate cover |
| **Records management** | the field of activity of legal entities that ensures the documentation and organisation of work with documents |
| **Document** | information recorded on a material medium that allows it to be identified |
| **Document of personal origin** | a document created by a person outside the sphere of their official activity or public duties |
| **Personnel records** | a set of documents confirming the employment of workers and information on contributions to their pension provision |
| **Document flow** | the movement of documents in an organisation from the moment they are created or received until their execution or dispatch is completed |
| **Storage unit** | an accounting or classification unit that is a physically separate document or a body of documents of independent significance |
| **Accounting unit** | a unit of measurement of the quantity of documents in an archive |
| **Use of archival documents** | the application of information from archival documents for cultural, scientific, political and economic purposes and to safeguard the lawful rights and interests of citizens |
| **Source of acquisition** | a legal entity or individual whose documents are transferred to the archive for state storage |
| **Historical note on an archival fonds** | a document containing information on the history of the fonds creator and the archival fonds, a brief description of the composition and content of its documents and of the finding aids |
| **Film document** | a pictorial document containing pictorial or audiovisual information recorded by cinematographic means |
| **Acquisition of the archive** | the systematic supplementing of the archive with documents in line with its profile and the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan |
| **Inter-archival finding aid** | an archival finding aid containing information on the documents of two or more archives |
| **National Archival Fonds** | the totality of all archives, archival fonds and collections, documentary monuments and documents of special historical, scientific, social, economic, political or cultural significance, recognised as a national treasure in the manner established by law |
| **Classification of files** | a systematic list of the titles of files opened in an organisation, indicating their retention periods, drawn up in the established manner |
| **Preservation of documents** | ensuring the physical and chemical safety of documents and their accounting |
| **Combined archival fonds** | an archival fonds formed from the documents of two or more fonds creators that have historically determined links with one another |
| **Organisational and administrative document** | a type of written document that records decisions on administrative and organisational matters, as well as on management, interaction, support and regulation of the activity of public authorities, institutions, enterprises, organisations, their units and officials |
| **Especially valuable document** | a document included in the National Archival Fonds of the Republic of Kazakhstan and irreplaceable if lost or damaged |
| **Official document** | a document created by an individual or legal entity and drawn up and certified in the established manner |
| **List of documents with retention periods** | a systematic list of types and categories of documents containing normative instructions on their retention periods |
| **User of archival documents** | an individual or legal entity that turns to archival documents to obtain information for its use |
| **Document element** | a mandatory element of the formatting of an official document |
| **Special state archive** | an archival institution or unit of a special state body of the Republic of Kazakhstan |
| **Insurance copy** | a copy of an especially valuable document made to preserve the information it contains in case the original is lost or damaged |
| **Authorised body** | the central state body for the management of archives and documentation |
| **Accounting of archival documents** | establishing the quantity and composition of archival documents in accounting units and recording in the accounting documents that each accounting unit belongs to a particular body of documents and to their total number |
| **Use fonds** | a body of copies of archival documents intended for use instead of the originals in order to prevent their wear |
| **Fonds creator** | a legal entity or individual in whose activity a documentary fonds is formed |
| **Allocation of documents to fonds** | the distribution of documents among archival fonds and archival collections |
| **Sound document** | a document containing sound information recorded by any sound-recording system |
| **Photographic document** | a pictorial document containing information recorded by photographic means |
| **Private archive** | an institution or structural unit of a non-state legal entity that collects, keeps and uses documents of the National Archival Fonds, as well as documents not included in it, or the archive of an individual that arose as a result of their activity or of collecting (acquiring) documents |
| **Appraisal of the value of documents** | the selection of documents for state storage, or the setting of their retention periods, on the basis of adopted criteria |
| **Banner** | a kind of advertising block that a user clicks to go to the advertised resource. Banners are placed on web pages to interest and attract potential customers to a resource, or to promote a brand. At present they can be counted among the most important tools of an effective advertising campaign |
| **Domain (domain name)** | a domain is a separate zone in the Domain Name System of the World Wide Web, given to the domain owner (which may be a country, an international organisation, a region, a company or a citizen) in order to provide access to information placed on the Internet that belongs to the domain owner. Here, a domain means a group of sites of an information network operating within one computer device, or under one network machine or node. Domains include .ru, .com, .org and so on |
| **Interactive interface** | in general, an interactive interface is a visual system that provides interaction between a user and a program |
| **Internet resource** | an electronic information resource, the technology of maintaining and/or using it, operating in an open information and communication network, as well as the organisational structure that provides information interaction |
| **Information system** | a system intended for storing, processing, searching, distributing, transmitting and providing information using a hardware and software complex |
| **Information technology** | a set of methods, production processes and hardware and software tools united in a technological complex that ensures the collection, creation, storage, accumulation, processing, search, output, copying, transmission and distribution of information |
| **Content** | the contents or, more simply, information |
| **Flash** | a software product for developing interactive multimedia applications, such as flash clips and flash banners, which help make your site come alive |

**State Flag of the Republic of Kazakhstan**

**![](old/akimsemey/state/2020/%D1%84%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B3.jpg)**

The State Flag of the Republic of Kazakhstan is a rectangular sky-blue cloth with the image of a sun with 32 rays in its centre, under which is a soaring steppe eagle. Along the hoist is a vertical band with a national ornament. The images of the sun, rays, eagle and ornament are golden. The ratio of the width of the Flag to its length is 1:2.

**State Emblem of the Republic of Kazakhstan**

![](old/akimsemey/state/2020/%D0%B3%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B1.png)

The State Emblem of the Republic of Kazakhstan is circular in shape and is an image of a shanyrak (the upper vaulted part of a yurt) on a sky-blue background, from which uyks (supporting poles) radiate in all directions like sun rays. To the right and left of the shanyrak are images of mythical winged horses. In the upper part is a three-dimensional five-pointed star, and in the lower part the inscription “Қазақстан”. The images of the star, shanyrak, uyks, mythical winged horses and the inscription “Қазақстан” are golden.

**State Anthem of the Republic of Kazakhstan**

**Words:** Nursultan Nazarbayev, Zhumeken Nazhimedenov
 **Music:** Shamshi Kaldayakov

![](old/akimsemey/state/2020/%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BD.png)

In its sky is a golden sun,
In its steppes is golden grain.
It is a poem of courage,
Look at my country!
In grey antiquity
Our glory was born.
Never losing honour,
Strong is my Kazakh people!

**Chorus:**

O my people! O my country!
I am a flower planted by you,
I am your flowing song, my country!
My native land is my Kazakhstan!
Opening the way for future generations
I have a wide, boundless land.
United in unity,
I have an independent country.
It greets the (new) time
Like an eternal friend.
Our country is happy,
Our country is such!

**Chorus:**

O my people! O my country!
I am a flower planted by you,
I am your flowing song, my country!
My native land is my Kazakhstan!

Documents of personal origin in state archives are one of the most important groups of historical sources and an integral part of a people’s historical and cultural heritage; they carry unique retrospective information refracted through the prism of personal perception. Their significance is especially great for studying the history of literature, science and the arts, that is, those aspects of human activity and of the historical process in which individual creativity comes to the fore. On the other hand, a distinctive feature of documents of personal origin is the extraordinary variety and many-sidedness of their content.

The inter-archival guide to the fonds of personal origin held in the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region is a practical way of quickly informing researchers about the composition, content and location of the documents of fonds and collections of personal origin.
 The State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region holds more than 60 fonds of personal origin.

Мемлекеттік архивтердегі жеке тектік құжаттар тарихи деректердің аса маңызды топтарының бірі болып табылады, халықтың тарихи-мәдени мұрасының ажырамас бөлігі болып саналады және жеке қабылдау призмасы арқылы өткен бірегей ретроспективті ақпаратты қамтиды. Олардың маңызы әдебиет, ғылым, өнер тарихын, яғни адам қызметі мен тарихи үдерістің жеке шығармашылық алдыңғы қатарға шығатын жақтарын зерттеуде ерекше зор. Екінші жағынан, жеке тектік құжаттардың ерекшелігі олардың мазмұнының ерекше алуан түрлілігі мен көпқырлылығында.

Шығыс Қазақстан облысының мемлекеттік архивінде сақталатын жеке тектік қорлар бойынша архив аралық нұсқаулық зерттеушілерге жеке тектік қорлар мен жинақтар құжаттарының құрамы, мазмұны, сақталатын орны туралы жылдам хабарлаудың нақты жолы болып табылады.
 Шығыс Қазақстан облысының мемлекеттік архивінде 60-тан астам жеке тектік қор сақталады.

fondsGroups.d: The earliest documents: the Ust-Kamenogorsk district revolutionary committee, the district executive committee, the military commissariat, special-purpose units.
Regional and city councils and executive committees, offices of the regional and city akims, maslikhats, district executive committees and district akims.

The Council of the National Economy, the Ust-Kamenogorsk lead-zinc and titanium-magnesium plants, the Belogorsk mining and processing plant, the Irtysh polymetallic plant, factories, light and food industry.
The Geological Department and expeditions, “Altaienergo”, the Ust-Kamenogorsk hydroelectric power station, “Irtyshgesstroy”.
VNIItsvetmet, Kazgiprotsvetmet, Kazgiprovodkhoz, “Vostokgrazhdanproekt”: administrative and scientific-technical documentation.
The regional committee, city and district committees of the party and Komsomol: the political and socio-economic history of the Kazakh SSR.
Agricultural and forestry institutions, “Kazles”, the construction trusts “Altaisvinetsstroy” and the “Irtysh Construction Department”.
The virgin lands campaign, the partisan movement, East Kazakhstan in 1941–1945, the history of sport, land management, documents from foreign archives, memoirs of veterans.
7,839 storage units: photographs of pre-revolutionary and present-day Ust-Kamenogorsk, films about non-ferrous metallurgy, sound recordings.
Scholars, writers, local historians, teachers and journalists of East Kazakhstan: Amanzholov, Volkov, Bokeyev, Gerasimov, the Belosludovs and others.

announcements.t: We accept documents of participants in the Great Patriotic War
announcements.d: The archive accepts for permanent storage letters from the front, award documents, photographs, diaries and memoirs of war participants and home-front workers. If you would rather not part with the originals, we will make copies and return the documents. Address: 26/1 Beybitshilik (Golovkov) St.

announcements.t: We are collecting documents of personal origin
announcements.d: Manuscripts, diaries, correspondence, photographs (please write the time, place and people on the back), biographical documents and materials on the creative and public activity of well-known fellow countrymen.

announcements.t: Searching for relatives of the soldier B. M. Shikhotov
announcements.d: The search team “Suvorov” found in Leningrad Region the remains of Sergeant Boris Mikhailovich Shikhotov, born in 1919, from Ust-Kamenogorsk (45 Sadovaya St.). If you know his relatives, please inform the archive.

announcements.t: Rehabilitation of victims of political repression
announcements.d: The State Commission for the full rehabilitation of victims of political repression is at work. Information about relatives who have not been rehabilitated can be submitted through the “Centre of Electronic Services” portal of East Kazakhstan Region.

databases.d: Changes in the borders and names of districts and settlements of East Kazakhstan over several decades.

Soldiers from the districts of the region who were killed, died of wounds or went missing in 1941–1945: full name, year and place of birth, military commissariat, date of death, place of burial. It is being added to: the Zaisan, Glubokoye, Markakol and Samara districts are being entered now.
Information about Heroes of the Soviet Union and Socialist Labour, honoured workers and famous people of East Kazakhstan.

Where a fonds is held, its number, inventories and extreme dates. Full text is partly available: the Ust-Kamenogorsk city executive committee, the fonds of Gerasimov, the Belosludovs, Konshin and Yaunrodzin.

history: The State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region was established, within the system of the NKVD of the Kazakh SSR.
The state archives of the USSR were included among research institutions.
The archive department passed from the Ministry of Internal Affairs to the regional executive committee.
The Zaisan and Zyryanovsk branches were created.
The Leninogorsk (now Ridder) branch was created. By 1967 the network of archives in the region was fully formed.
Self-financing archives of personnel records were created under the district and city executive committees.
On 13 November the building of the former party archive was transferred to the archive.
The archive department was reorganised into the administration of archives and documentation.
After the abolition of Semipalatinsk Region, the Ayagoz and Zharma branches were added.
On 7 May the archive and its branches became independent legal entities.
The archive became the Communal State Institution “State Archive”.
The branches were re-established, including the Ust-Kamenogorsk personnel records branch.
The Zyryanovsk branch was renamed the Altai branch.
The archive passed under the Department of Digitalisation and Archives of East Kazakhstan Region.
The Ayagoz and Zharma branches passed to the new Abai Region.

By resolution of the East Kazakhstan Regional Akimat of 2 June 2026 No. 142, nine district branches were created at the archive: Glubokoye, Katon-Karagay, Kurchum, Markakol, Samar, Tarbagatay, Ulan, Ulken Naryn and Shemonaikha; four existing branches were renamed (Ust-Kamenogorsk city personnel records, Ridder city, Altai district, Zaisan district).

notices.t: On conducting an internal analysis of corruption risks
d: The Communal State Institution “State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region” of the Department of Digitalisation and Archives of East Kazakhstan Region, in order to prevent corruption offences and to identify the conditions and causes that contribute to corruption offences in organisational, managerial and core activity, begins an internal analysis of corruption risks on 11 September 2026.

notices.t: Information on the implementation of the internal analysis of corruption risks
d: The Communal State Institution “State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region” of the Department of Digitalisation and Archives of East Kazakhstan Region (hereinafter the Institution) has carried out an internal analysis of corruption risks, on the results of which an analytical note was prepared.

In addition, within the analysis a list of positions exposed to corruption risks was drawn up, and an Action Plan to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to corruption offences identified by the internal analysis of corruption risks in the Institution was developed and approved.
These documents are posted on the information website “State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region and its branches”.

In order to implement the Action Plan and ensure compliance with the requirements of anti-corruption legislation in the field of public procurement, persons responsible for organising and conducting public procurement were appointed (order of 21.10.2026 No. 123).

In addition, in order to strengthen control over compliance with the established requirements when providing paid services, persons responsible for organising and providing paid services were appointed by order of 21.10.2026 No. 124.
In order to prevent and avoid conflicts of interest when hiring, order of 22.10.2026 No. 125 “On the work of the personnel service” was approved.

Thus, the Institution is taking the necessary organisational and preventive measures to eliminate the identified corruption risks, prevent corruption offences and ensure compliance with the requirements of anti-corruption legislation.

fondsGroups.d: Ең ерте құжаттар: Өскемен уездік революциялық комитеті, уездік атқару комитеті, әскери комиссариат, ерекше мақсаттағы бөлімдер.
Облыстық және қалалық кеңестер мен атқару комитеттері, облыс және қала әкімдерінің аппараттары, мәслихаттар, аудандық атқару комитеттері мен аудан әкімдері.
Халық шаруашылығы кеңесі, Өскемен қорғасын-мырыш және титан-магний комбинаттары, Белогор тау-кен байыту комбинаты, Ертіс полиметалл комбинаты, зауыттар, жеңіл және тамақ өнеркәсібі.
Геология басқармасы мен экспедициялар, «Алтайэнерго», Өскемен СЭС-і, «Иртышгэсстрой».
ВНИИцветмет, Казгипроцветмет, Казгипроводхоз, «Востокгражданпроект»: басқарушылық және ғылыми-техникалық құжаттама.
Партия мен комсомолдың обкомы, қалалық және аудандық комитеттері: Қазақ КСР-інің саяси және әлеуметтік-экономикалық тарихы.
Ауыл және орман шаруашылығы мекемелері, «Казлес», «Алтайсвинецстрой» және «Ертіс құрылыс басқармасы» құрылыс тресттері.
Тың игеру, партизан қозғалысы, 1941–1945 жылдардағы Шығыс Қазақстан, спорт тарихы, жер орналастыру, шетелдік архивтердегі құжаттар, ардагерлердің естеліктері.
7 839 сақтау бірлігі: революцияға дейінгі және қазіргі Өскеменнің фотосуреттері, түсті металлургия туралы деректі фильмдер, фонограммалар.
Шығыс Қазақстанның ғалымдары, жазушылары, өлкетанушылары, педагогтері, журналистері: Аманжолов, Волков, Бөкеев, Герасимов, Белослюдовтар және басқалары.

announcements.d: «Суворов» іздеу отряды Ленинград облысында Өскемендік (Садовая көшесі, 45), 1919 жылы туған старшина Борис Михайлович Шихотовтың сүйегін тапты. Оның туыстарын білсеңіз, архивке хабарлаңыз.
Саяси қуғын-сүргін құрбандарын толық ақтау жөніндегі мемлекеттік комиссия жұмыс істейді. Ақталмаған туыстар туралы мәліметті ШҚО-ның «Электрондық қызметтер орталығы» порталы арқылы беруге болады.

databases.d: Шығыс Қазақстанның аудандары мен елді мекендерінің шекаралары мен атауларының бірнеше онжылдықтағы өзгерістері.

1941–1945 жылдары қаза тапқан, жараларынан қайтыс болған немесе хабар-ошарсыз кеткен облыс аудандарының жауынгерлері: аты-жөні, туған жылы мен жері, әскери комиссариат, қаза болған күні, жерленген орны. Толықтырылып жатыр: қазір Зайсан, Глубокое, Маркакөл және Самар аудандары енгізілуде.
Кеңес Одағының және Социалистік Еңбектің Батырлары, еңбек сіңірген қызметкерлер және Шығыс Қазақстанның белгілі адамдары туралы мәліметтер.
Қордың қайда сақталатыны, нөмірі, тізімдемелері және аяққы күндері. Толық мәтіні ішінара қолжетімді: Өскемен қалалық атқару комитеті, Герасимов, Белослюдовтар, Коншин, Яунродзинь қорлары.

Лениногор (қазіргі Риддер) филиалы құрылды. 1967 жылға қарай облыстағы архивтер желісі толық қалыптасты.
Аудандық-қалалық атқару комитеттерінің жанынан жеке құрам бойынша шаруашылық есептегі архивтер құрылды.
13 қарашада архивке бұрынғы партия архивінің ғимараты берілді.
Архив бөлімі архивтер және құжаттама басқармасына қайта құрылды.
Семей облысы таратылғаннан кейін Аягөз және Жарма филиалдары қосылды.
7 мамырда архив пен филиалдар дербес заңды тұлғаларға айналды.
Архив «Мемлекеттік архив» КММ болды.
Филиалдар қайта құрылды, соның ішінде Өскемен жеке құрам бойынша филиалы.
Зырян филиалы Алтай филиалы болып қайта аталды.
Архив ШҚО цифрландыру және архивтер басқармасының қарауына өтті.
Аягөз және Жарма филиалдары жаңа Абай облысына өтті.

Шығыс Қазақстан облысы әкімдігінің 2026 жылғы 2 маусымдағы № 142 қаулысымен архив жанынан тоғыз аудандық филиал құрылды: Глубокое, Катонқарағай, Күршім, Марқакөл, Самар, Тарбағатай, Ұлан, Үлкен Нарын, Шемонаиха; жұмыс істеп тұрған төрт филиал қайта аталды (Өскемен қалалық жеке құрам бойынша, Риддер қалалық, Алтай аудандық, Зайсан аудандық).
